user_problem: Role notes describe capabilities inconsistently, leaving unclear which operations are allowed under which conditions.
unique_output: A resource-operation matrix with allow, deny, conditional, unspecified, and conflict cells plus cited conditions.
required_input: Roles, resources, operations, permission statements, exceptions, and source labels supplied by the user.
critical_rule: Absence of an allow statement means unspecified, not denied, unless a supplied default-deny rule applies.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is approval-path-mapper; this specifies application permissions rather than sequencing organizational approvals.
acceptance_scenario: Input says Editors may update articles, Guests may view published articles, and default deny applies. Output allows Editor/update/article, conditionally allows Guest/view/article when published, and denies unmentioned operations under the stated default.
